question: What immediate condition and strength does an accomplished-mantra practitioner attain on earth?
premises: A practitioner possesses an accomplished mantra.
The resulting state arises at that very time.
The practitioner becomes superior in strength on earth.
inference: Mantra accomplishment immediately confers superior strength upon the practitioner in the earthly realm.
plain_english: But one whose mantra is accomplished immediately becomes superior in strength on earth.
